sentences.english: Yang Ling wants to visit Su Hai's new home.
sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.chinese: 杨玲想拜访苏海的新家。

sentences.english: How do I get to your home, Su Hai?
sentences.speaker: Yang Ling

sentences.english: You can get on the metro at Park Station and get off at City Library Station.
sentences.speaker: Su Hai
sentences.chinese: 你可以在公园站上地铁，在城市图书馆站下车。

sentences.english: There's a bookshop on the street.
sentences.speaker: Su Hai
sentences.grammarAnalysis: There is + 名词 + 地点

sentences.english: My home is next to it.
sentences.speaker: Su Hai

sentences.english: Yang Ling comes out of City Library Station.
sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.chinese: 杨玲从城市图书馆站出来。

sentences.english: She asks a policeman for help.
sentences.speaker: narrator
Yang Ling
sentences.grammarAnalysis: Excuse me 打扰别人时用

sentences.english: Excuse me, how do I get to the bookshop on Moon Street?
sentences.speaker: Yang Ling
sentences.chinese: 打扰一下，我怎么到月亮街上的那家书店？
sentences.grammarAnalysis: Excuse me + How 询问路线

sentences.english: Turn right at the traffic lights.
sentences.speaker: Policeman

sentences.english: You can see the bookshop on your right.
sentences.speaker: Policeman
sentences.chinese: 你能看到你右边的书店。
sentences.grammarAnalysis: can see + 宾语 + 方位
